responsibility: Contains the rs6000 hooks that adapt GCC’s C-family front ends to PowerPC-specific language behavior. It handles pragmas such as #pragma longcall, defines and conditionally expands target preprocessor macros and AltiVec keyword macros, initializes target-specific builtin and vector keyword state, and resolves overloaded AltiVec/VSX builtin calls in the front end by matching argument types to generated rs6000 builtin instances and issuing target-option diagnostics when needed.
